verses.text: For the choirmaster. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth!

xrefs.text: Sing to the LORD, all the earth. Proclaim His salvation day after day.
A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth— let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!
For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. Of Asaph. Sing for joy to God our strength; make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob.

verses.text: Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.

xrefs.text: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.

And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!
Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth; break forth in song, O mountains! For the LORD has comforted His people, and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.
Let them give glory to the LORD and declare His praise in the islands.
and on that day you will say: “Give praise to the LORD; proclaim His name! Make His works known among the peoples; declare that His name is exalted.

verses.text: Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.

xrefs.text: When they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.
With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience, and their doom would last forever.
How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.

verses.text: All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah

xrefs.text: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.

For My name will be great among the nations, from where the sun rises to where it sets. In every place, incense and pure offerings will be presented in My name, because My name will be great among the nations,” says the LORD of Hosts.

verses.text: Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.

xrefs.text: A song of ascents. When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
For there is no spell against Jacob and no divination against Israel. It will now be said of Jacob and Israel, ‘What great things God has done!’
Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.
Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.

verses.text: He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the waters on foot; there we rejoiced in Him.

xrefs.text: the flowing water stood still. It backed up as far upstream as Adam, a city in the area of Zarethan, while the water flowing toward the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea was completely cut off. So the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the LORD drove back the sea with a strong east wind that turned it into dry land. So the waters were divided,
He split the sea and brought them through; He set the waters upright like a wall.
Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the LORD: “I will sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted. The horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.
So when the people broke camp to cross the Jordan, the priests carried the ark of the covenant ahead of them.

verses.text: He rules forever by His power; His eyes watch the nations. Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah

xrefs.text: The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.

For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth, to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose hearts are fully devoted to Him. You have acted foolishly in this matter. From now on, therefore, you will be at war.”
Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
But when his heart became arrogant and his spirit was hardened with pride, he was deposed from his royal throne, and his glory was taken from him.
God is wise in heart and mighty in strength. Who has resisted Him and prospered?

verses.text: Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard.

xrefs.text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth— let your cry ring out, and sing praises!

the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom, and the voices of those bringing thank offerings into the house of the LORD, saying: ‘Give thanks to the LORD of Hosts, for the LORD is good; His loving devotion endures forever.’ For I will restore the land from captivity as in former times, says the LORD.
After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.

verses.text: He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.

xrefs.text: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.

verses.text: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.

xrefs.text: See, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.
You have tried my heart; You have visited me in the night. You have tested me and found no evil; I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.
In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials
A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold, but the LORD is the tester of hearts.
Yet He knows the way I have taken; when He has tested me, I will come forth as gold.

verses.text: You led us into the net; You laid burdens on our backs.

xrefs.text: He sent fire from on high, and it overpowered my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.
But I will spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, and there he will die.
then understand that it is God who has wronged me and drawn His net around me.
As they go, I will spread My net over them; I will bring them down like birds of the air. I will chastise them when I hear them flocking together.
Bless his substance, O LORD, and accept the work of his hands. Smash the loins of those who rise against him, and of his foes so they can rise no more.”

verses.text: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but You brought us into abundance.

xrefs.text: But now, this is what the LORD says— He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
I will place it in the hands of your tormentors, who told you: ‘Lie down, so we can walk over you,’ so that you made your back like the ground, like a street to be traversed.”
See how blessed we consider those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.
so that none of you would be shaken by these trials. For you know that we are destined for this.

verses.text: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—

xrefs.text: When you make a vow to God, do not delay in fulfilling it, because He takes no pleasure in fools. Fulfill your vow.
Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.
I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.

verses.text: the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress.

xrefs.text: And she made a vow, saying, “O LORD of Hosts, if only You will look upon the affliction of Your maidservant and remember me, not forgetting Your maidservant but giving her a son, then I will dedicate him to the LORD all the days of his life, and no razor shall ever touch his head.”

As soon as Jephthah saw her, he tore his clothes and said, “No! Not my daughter! You have brought me to my knees! You have brought great misery upon me, for I have given my word to the LORD and cannot take it back.”
In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.
If a man makes a vow to the LORD or swears an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word; he must do everything he has promised.
But if her husband prohibits her when he hears of it, he nullifies the vow that binds her or the rash promise she has made, and the LORD will absolve her.

verses.text: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah

xrefs.text: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
eighty men who had shaved off their beards, torn their garments, and cut themselves came from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria, carrying grain offerings and frankincense for the house of the LORD.
When those carrying the ark of the LORD had advanced six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.

and he is to present an offering to the LORD of an unblemished year-old male lamb as a burnt offering, an unblemished year-old female lamb as a sin offering, and an unblemished ram as a peace offering—
So they brought the ark of the LORD and set it in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it. Then David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

verses.text: Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.

xrefs.text: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

At that time those who feared the LORD spoke with one another, and the LORD listened and heard them. So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the LORD and honored His name.
My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.

verses.text: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.

xrefs.text: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.
Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.

verses.text: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.

xrefs.text: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but He does listen to the one who worships Him and does His will.
Whoever turns his ear away from hearing the law, even his prayer is detestable.
The LORD is far from the wicked, but He hears the prayer of the righteous.
The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is His delight.
When you spread out your hands in prayer, I will hide My eyes from you; even though you multiply your prayers, I will not listen. Your hands are covered with blood.

verses.text: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.

xrefs.text: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the depths of the Pit.
During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.
The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.

verses.text: Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion!

xrefs.text: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God!
Cast me not away from Your presence; take not Your Holy Spirit from me.
I will be his Father, and he will be My son. When he does wrong, I will discipline him with the rod of men and with the blows of the sons of men.
For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.
